carrier_name: Mutual of Omaha (United of Omaha Life Insurance Company)

must_contain: United of Omaha Life Insurance Company
any_of: Underwritten by United of Omaha Life Insurance Company

extraction_notes:
This is a multi-product Mutual of Omaha (underwritten by United of Omaha Life Insurance Co.) group insurance proposal. Each product (Basic Term Life and AD&D, Voluntary Term Life and AD&D, Preferred Choice Voluntary STD, LTD, Voluntary Dental, Voluntary Critical Illness, Voluntary Hospital Indemnity, Voluntary Accident, Voluntary Vision) is presented as its own multi-page section with header "BENEFIT SUMMARY" and "PARTICIPATION AND COST SUMMARY" blocks.

For BASIC TERM LIFE AND AD&D (the only product extracted here): appears early in doc (page 2-3), titled "BASIC TERM LIFE AND AD&D INSURANCE". Only 1 class ("Class 1: All Eligible Employees"). Benefit is a single flat amount table (Benefit/Maximum Benefit/Guarantee Issue Amount/Minimum Benefit - all equal, e.g. $50,000). AD&D benefit amount equals the Basic Life amount (Principal Sum = Life amount), so AD&D typically has no separate benefit formula, just "equal to life amount."

Rates are found in "COST SUMMARY" table under "PARTICIPATION AND COST SUMMARY" section: rows for "Employee Term Life" and "Employee AD&D", each with columns Number of Lives, Total Monthly Volume, Monthly Rate (per $1,000), Total Monthly Premium, Total Annual Premium. Extract the "Monthly Rate" column value (formatted like "$0.125/$1,000") as rate_per_unit with basis "per $1,000 of coverage". This is a flat-rate (not age-banded, not tiered) pricing model since benefit is a single flat amount for all employees.

Contribution structure found in "PARTICIPATION ASSUMPTIONS" table (e.g. "Non-Contributory" = 100% employer paid, or "100% employee paid" for voluntary products).

Guarantee issue amount and benefit amounts found in "BENEFIT SUMMARY" section tables per class.

Note: this document contains many other products (LTD/STD priced per $100 of payroll with age-banded or flat rates elsewhere, Voluntary Life priced age-banded per $1,000, Dental/Vision/Accident/Hospital Indemnity/Critical Illness priced per tier or age-band) - these should be extracted separately as age_banded or simple_tiered products, NOT flat_rate, when instructed to do so. Only Basic Life/AD&D and LTD/STD (per payroll) fit the flat_rate schema in this carrier's documents typically. Total count of relevant flat-rate entries for Basic Life/AD&D section: 2 (Employee Term Life, Employee AD&D) - single class, no dependent tiers for basic coverage.
